themes.evidence: Expertise with Python, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI frameworks
Experimentation and iteration (rapidly test and refine with user feedback)
Collaborate closely with PMs, UX designers, and Research & Signals Lead
Test feasibility and performance of AI behaviors in real workflow scenarios

archetype_rationale: The role is explicitly a 'Forward-Deployed AI Engineer' embedded in a discovery team, rapidly prototyping AI solutions in real-world advisor workflows alongside PMs, UX, and researchers — collapsing the gap between concept and reality rather than building production systems.
notes: Advisor-facing prototypes, not end customers — the 'client' is the internal advisor workflow. Heavy emphasis on speed/feasibility validation and handoff to downstream production teams; prototypes are throwaway-grade, so engineering-rigor/platform themes were deliberately not picked despite the AI-engineering title.
